author: TurkishDelite
body:
ok so i have wanted to talk about this for a while now and decided to do it now. lets start off with the kits, they have changed up the armour and weapons for some kits and i think its great that they're trying to balance the game... i thought wrong.

ok so you got rid of kits like heavy, tank, scout and yeti. i understand that they were all OP in there own way but... YOU KEPT DEMO out of all classes YOU KEPT DEMO, like really you got rid of classes that could survive grenades such as tank and heavy and classes that could doge the bomb like scout and yeti but you kept the one class that can pretty much one shot all the classes now... can a staff tell me a reasoning behind it like i seriously dont understand why they still keep demo....









Also fix fasthit glitch!
